card.lead: The first Visa card from your dollar balance — built for nomads from the CIS. No staking. No fear of being frozen out.
card.f1Desc: 12.5M nomads from the CIS are cut off from most crypto cards. We operate legally: a VASP license and a bank co-brand.
card.f2Desc: No staking, no annual fee. The rate is locked before payment and never changes after.
card.f3Desc: A friend sends you USDT — you spend it with the card right away. Instant and nearly free.

security.label: Security
security.title: Money nobody can reach
security.c1Desc: We physically cannot freeze it — control over your funds belongs to you alone.
security.c2Title: The fee is visible before confirmation
security.c2Desc: And never after. No retroactive charges.
security.c3Desc: A VASP license and a card-issuing bank. We operate through regulated institutions — jurisdictions are listed in the footer.
security.h1a: Only you. The access key is split across several independent environments — your device and secure infrastructure. None of them alone grants access, and Frameless has no master switch.
security.h2q: What happens with the fee when I pay?
security.h2a: Before you confirm a payment you see the total and the fee. After confirmation the amount never changes — this is fixed in the logic of every transaction.
security.h3q: Who issues the card and regulates the service?
security.h3a: Cards are issued by a partner bank; digital asset operations run through a licensed VASP. Frameless is the technology layer and interface, not a bank.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Honest answers — no marketing, no fine print.
faq.a1: No. Frameless is a technology company and interface. Cards are issued by a partner bank; digital asset operations run through a licensed VASP. We don't hold your money on our balance.
faq.a2: You do. Funds sit in your wallet and the access key is controlled by you. Frameless cannot freeze or seize your money — technically there's no way.
faq.a3: Yes. The service operates through a licensed VASP and a partner card-issuing bank. Exact jurisdictions and license details are listed in the footer and will be updated as we launch.
faq.q4: Is it available in my country?
faq.a4: First of all — for nomads from the CIS: today 12.5M people are cut off from most crypto cards. At launch — Thailand, UAE, Georgia, Turkey, Vietnam. The Visa card works in 200+ countries; country-specific restrictions will be published before launch.
faq.q5: What are the fees and where is the full price list?
faq.a5: Low FX without staking on dollar payments, 0.8–1.5% in other currencies, transfers inside Frameless are nearly free, eSIM from $3.50, cash withdrawals 2% (min. $3). The full price list will be in the app before your first payment.
faq.q6: What do I need to sign up (identity check)?
faq.a6: An email and a short identity check (selfie + document) — a standard requirement of the partner bank and VASP. Takes a few minutes, right in the app.
faq.q7: What is the Tax Day Tracker and why do I need it?
faq.a7: It reminds you about the 183-day rule: days spent in a country affect your tax residency. The tracker counts days for you and warns as you approach the threshold. It's a convenient counter, not tax advice.
faq.q8: When is the launch and how do I get the first wave?
faq.a8: Launch is staged; waitlist members get access first. Leave your email and you'll be invited among the first. The first 1,000 subscribers get early access and the lowest FX for their first 3 months.
